points.en: Animal Husbandry is a crucial sub-sector of agriculture in the Indian economy, contributing significantly to agricultural GDP and rural employment.
points.hi: Animal Husbandry is a crucial sub-sector of agriculture in the Indian economy, contributing significantly to agricultural GDP and rural employment.

points.en: It acts as a vital source of livelihood for small and marginal farmers, landless laborers, and women, promoting inclusive rural growth.

points.en: Provides a reliable cushion against crop failures and drought, enhancing farmer income stability.

points.en: Major segments include dairy, poultry, sheep, goat, and piggery, with India being one of the largest global producers of milk.

points.en: Key governmental interventions include Rashtriya Gokul Mission, National Livestock Mission, and Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF).
points.hi: Key governmental interventions include Rashtriya Gokul Mission, National Livestock Mission, and Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF).

points.en: Focuses on genetic improvement of cattle, disease control (foot-and-mouth disease), and enhancing value addition in the dairy and meat processing sectors.
